question: Can I legally carry out the proposed building work?
guardrails: Planning permission does not by itself establish compliance with Building Regulations.
Building Regulations compliance does not by itself grant planning permission.
A commencement notice is not the same thing as a planning permission.
A commencement notice or 7-day notice must not be treated as proof that completed work complies with all applicable requirements.
Completion evidence must be distinguished from planning permission and title evidence.
Historical construction requires the law and building-control regime applicable at the time.
Specialist review may be required for structural, fire-safety, accessibility, energy-performance or other technical questions.
